# Stand Firm in the Battle
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong. Let all that you do be done in love." – 1 Corinthians 16:13-14

## Reflection
Brother, there is a difference between being strong and acting like a man. The world tells you that strength is domination, independence, and never showing weakness. But Paul calls us to something higher. He commands us to be watchful—alert to the enemy’s schemes. To stand firm—not in our own power, but in the faith. And then, in the same breath, he says to let it all be done in love.

That is the warrior’s paradox. You are called to be a man of steel and tenderness. You fight not to crush, but to protect. You stand firm so that others can find refuge. Your strength is not for your own glory, but for the Kingdom. Today, check your posture. Are you standing in faith, or are you leaning on your own understanding? Are you loving fiercely, or are you just fighting to win?

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and for every rep, say aloud: "I stand firm in faith. I fight in love."
